newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares cool off in high trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares cool off in high trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares slid in hectic trade on Monday, ending a bull run which saw the bourse climb to new highs in the first three weeks of 1997, dealers said.
Central market volume was 5.3 million litas and the Group A index fell by 205.77 points to 3,036.49.
Dealers said the sharp drop in Lithuania Gas was the main reason behind the fall in the index.
Lithuania Gas saw its shares fall by about 19 percent to 2.37 litas from 2.96 litas in turnover worth over 1.5 million litas.
But not all of the country's blue chip stocks fell.
Birziu Dairy's shares climbed to 16.41 litas from 13.68, a jump of 19.98 percent, in trade worth almost 1.75 million litas.
Block trades worth over 1.8 million litas were made on Monday while the volume on the secondary T-bill market was only 74,000 litas.
